# Review — cid-tiradas-87-90 (tiradas 87–90, lines 1610–1656 with 1615b)

Adversarial review against the pinned packet, the scan (PDF pp. 236–239 at 200 dpi, lines 1620 and 1633 cropped at
400 dpi; introduction pp. 75–77 and 93 = PDF 79–81 and 97, for the references in the notes to vv. 1639 and 1655),
conventions.md, the pilot (01-04), the published parts (18 for v. 300 and v. 371, 32-34 for virtos, 44-48 for
deliçio, 64-68 for conquistas and Padre spirital, 78-82 to 84-86 for bracket practice in `l`), the established
texts (cross-references only) and known-forms.json. All edits by script (json load/dump, ensure_ascii=False,
indent=1). No `t` changed: the 48 `t` lines joined with "\n" equal the packet's 48 verses (1610–1656 with 1615b),
checked by script before and after the edits; one `l` line per `t` line in all 20 units.

## Pass 1 — units.json

Counts: error 1 · weak 10 · style 4 (15 changes; the last style row holds two)

| unit (index / first line) | field | sev. | what was wrong | what was done |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 / 1622 Pesól | l | error | "non gelo gradeçe" as "not to-me-it": ge is 3rd person (the note itself says 'it to him'), pointing on to a Jesu Cristo | "not to-him-it" |
| 12 / 1639 Venídom | n | weak | "Pidal's note sends to pp. 75–76; the exact sense of the word here is not certain": Pidal does read it, quoting the line on p. 77: the fierce joy of the fight, the battle "delicioso regalo traído de África" | the false hedge dropped; Pidal's reading given |
| 19 / 1654 con la merced | n | weak | note reported "p. 93, n. 2" only: in this printing p. 93 has no footnote; the line (with 1653–54) is quoted on p. 77, where the ladies' presence "le aumenta el coraje" | reference kept, the absence stated, p. 77 added |
| 7 / 1629 Arribado an | n | weak | "its participle unchanged though naves is feminine plural": implies naves is an object; in the unit's reading (l, i) naves is the subject of intransitive arribar, and aver never agrees with a subject | says naves is the subject, arribar intransitive, participle agrees only with an object |
| 5 / 1622 | n | weak | "gives thanks, and owes homage, to none but Christ": homage not in the text | "gives thanks for his gains to none but Christ"; ge's reference to a Jesu Cristo said |
| 6 / 1625 Aquel rey | n | weak | virtos stated flat as 'forces, hosts', from virtus: the word is doubtful (known glossary, 32-34 note to v. 657) | "most likely … as at v. 657, perhaps from Latin virtus … not certain" |
| 8 / 1630 Llegaron | n | weak | "the form is uncertain", with no support given for the participle reading | v. 1093 conquistas = conquistadas (published 64-68) cited; reading called the likelier, the noun not ruled out |
| 10 / 1635 con afán | i, n | weak | i "I cannot give her up" against l "I-could" and the preterite form; note "the sense calls for a present" overstates | i "short of death I could not give her up"; note: 3rd-sg shape, the Çid speaking, 'I could not (would not be able to)', no Pidal note, uncertain |
| 11 / 1637 grado al Criador | n | weak | que las tengo acá given only as relative + resumptive las; que 'that' after grado is equally possible | both readings given |
| 13 / 1642 en estas tierras | i, n | weak | i "how life is lived here": a free paraphrase going beyond the uncertain moradas (possible remembered English); rebuilt from the grammar | i "they will see how homes are made"; note says the translation keeps the literal sense |
| 16 / 1649 a poco que | i | weak | "of an age to marry" for por casar ('yet to be married'); "their dowry goods" ambiguous (whose?) | "your daughters are yet to be married, and they bring you a trousseau for them" |

| 0 / 1610 | l | style | en el más alto logar as "to the most high place" | "in the most high place" |
| 2 / 1615 / 3 / 1618 | l, i | style | l "for-this gain" for desta (of this); i "in the greatest delight" for tan a grand sabor (superlative not in the text) | "of-this gain"; "in such great delight" |

Checked and found sound (no change):
- Scan: rubrics of 87 (p. 232 "Las dueñas contemplan a Valencia desde el alcázar"), 88 (p. 233 "El rey de Marruecos
  viene a cercar a Valencia") and 90 ("Alegría del Cid al ver las huestes de Marruecos. — Temor de Jimena") as the
  notes give them; tirada 89 has no rubric (number only), as the note says. 1615b: printed wholly in italics,
  no number or letter in the margin (labels 1610, 1615, 1620 only), no footnote — the note is right. Margin labels
  1625, 1630, 1635, 1640, 1645, 1650, 1655 as the packet.
- Footnotes, wording and numbers right: 1621 (Yúcef, emperador almorávide, pp. 27 y 17), 1633 (conjunción e
  pleonástica, v. 300; v. 300 checked in 18-18), 1644 (Florence de Rome, chanson du premier quart du XIIIe siècle,
  vv. 1059–80; Otas/Ríos not carried, harmless), 1650 ('os traen el ajuar' para el casamiento; axuvar v. 2571).
  No false "no note" claim.
- Italics on the scan match `t` and notes: alcáç[e]r ×3, fuertemie[n]tre, f[o]ron, a[l] (italic l at 400 dpi),
  dela[n]t, ve[e]rme, vi[di]eron, finca[r], se[e]d, 1615b whole line.
- Assonances: 87 á (with á-e: partes, alcáçer), 88 í-o, 89 í-a, 90 á with á-e; word lists right.
- Cross-references checked: v. 2 (catar), 300, 657, 1093, 1571, 1573b (arrancada), 1580 (adeliñava), 1603.
- Grammar labels right: adeliñó, subie (imperfect -ie), yaze, del otra (el before vowel), han, es exido, quiere
  entrar, pesól, es metido (ser + part.), gelo, ajuntava, f[o]ron, son metidos (tense-mixing), van buscar, eran
  exidos, a conquista, posan, eran venidas, he, ela, a menos de, venídom es, podré, ve[e]rme an (split future),
  se fazen / se gana (passive se), subiólas (resumptive), quês, ayades (polite negative command), acreçe,
  viniestes (2nd pl.), adúzenvos, se[e]d (imperative of seer), veades, créçem (dative), estades, la he de.
- House renderings: "my Çid", "the spiritual Father" (1633 folded by Pidal's pleonastic e; 1651 "and to the
  spiritual Father"), Yúcef in `l` / Yúsuf in `i`, Morocco, Valencia, Don Rodrigo.
- `l` letter-brackets (beyo[n]d, we[r]e, befo[r]e, sa[w], st[a]y, see[e]) follow 83b/84-86 practice (hi[e]s, wa[s]).

Findings refused:
- 1621 i "Now I will tell you" for Dezir vos quiero: quiero + infinitive is the minstrel's formula of intent; the
  rendering is within its force. Kept.
- 1619 i "and" for que 'for' (note): the causal link is weak in English either way; kept.
- 1629 i "the men have gone ashore" for eran exidos (pluperfect form): epic tense-mixing; kept.
- 1646/1647 i "Ah, honoured wife" for Ya ('O'): acceptable English vocative. Kept.
- 1620 alle[n]t: the n looks no different at 400 dpi in this scan; the pinned text is the authority; not touched.

## Pass 2 — gloss.json

Counts: error 2 · weak 8 · style 3 (13 changes, 2 of them new broadens)

| entry | sev. | what was wrong | what was done |
|---|---|---|---|
| vellidos | error | "not the modern vellido 'downy'": no such modern sense (modern velludo/velloso); invented | "= bellido (archaic), hermoso" |
| afarto | error | "= harto, de sobra, a placeholder for the old form": nonsense | "a + farto = harto … = hasta hartarse, de sobra" |
| arribado | weak | "brought the ships to land" (transitive), against the unit (naves the subject) | intransitive 'arrived', participle invariable, naves subject |
| conquista | weak | not aligned with the revised note | short participle = conquistada, v. 1093 compared, likelier, noun not ruled out |
| puodo | weak | "he could … person uncertain": the Çid speaks of himself | 3rd-sg shape, 'I could' here, odd, uncertain |
| venídom | weak | "past part. venído": no such form; the accent belongs to the clitic group | venido + me, the accent marking the stress |
| moradas | weak | "'camp-dwellings' or 'sojourns'": not the unit's alternatives | 'dwellings' or 'how one makes one's dwelling', uncertain |
| presend | weak | "apocopated presende": no form presende | apocopated presente, final -d |
| gana | weak | entry only passive 'is won': not general to the form | 'he wins, earns'; with se passive |
| __broaden__ an (new) | weak | known an has no split-future use; ve[e]rme an (v. 1641) uncovered | old entry whole + " · also future auxiliary … (ve[e]rme an …; = me verán)" |
| yúcef | style | "= Yúsuf": the Spanish form is Yusuf; Pidal's gloss missing | "= Yusuf", Pidal's 'emperador almorávide' added |
| axuvar | style | Pidal's gloss absent | Pidal's 'os traen el ajuar para el casamiento' added |
| __broaden__ quiere (new) | style | known 'he wants' does not cover el março quiere entrar 'is about to' | broadened |

Broadens checked by script: all 8 (ela, se, fazen, metido, poco, arrancar, an, quiere) begin with the known entry
exactly + " · ". Keys of gloss.json minus __broaden__ = the 51 keys of novel-forms.json.
Checked and found sound: the other novel entries (subie, catan, miran, yaze, huerta, espessa, alçan, ivierno,
março, allent, pesól, gradeçe, jesu, cristo, ajuntava, vezes, conplidos, barcas, metidos, naves, posan,
descreidas, venidas, espirital, afán, muert, podré, veerme, agenas, verán, subiólas, alçavan, quês, acreçe,
viniestes, casar, adúzenvos, pavor, veades, créçem). Known entries otherwise cover their uses here (a, de, por,
sobre, que, la que, han, he + de, sí, ya, deliçio, fincar).

Findings refused:
- mar "here fem." in the known entry, while this part has del mar: a known entry describing another passage, not
  wrong; left to the owner.
- conplidos "exact sense somewhat uncertain": a fair hedge; kept.

## Readings left flagged uncertain
- 1630 a conquista: short participle (likelier) or the noun.
- 1636 puodo: 3rd-singular form in the Çid's mouth; reading not certain.
- 1642 moradas … cómmo se fazen: 'dwellings' or 'how one dwells'.
- 1625 virtos: 'forces, hosts', most likely.
- 1626 conplidos (gloss): exact sense.
